title: AI helpers: switches
note: Plain-English texts for the (i) info sheet of each AI switch. Every entry says what it does, why it matters, the default, what changes if it is switched, and who can change it. English only. Keys are the rule keys of supabase/phase484.sql.

rule:ai_on.title: AI helpers are on (after a provider is linked)
rule:ai_on.does: Lets the AI helpers run. Nothing runs while this is off, and no provider is called and no money is spent.
rule:ai_on.why: This is the main on/off for every AI helper. It is safe to leave off until a provider and a monthly budget are set.
rule:ai_on.default: Off. No AI call is made and nothing is spent.
rule:ai_on.change: On: the helpers that are switched on for their own agent can make suggestions, within the provider budget. Every answer is a suggestion a person reviews. Nothing is changed by the AI itself.

rule:ai_pause_all.title: Pause all AI now (emergency stop)
rule:ai_pause_all.does: Stops every AI agent and every provider at once. No new suggestion or proposal is made while it is on.
rule:ai_pause_all.why: If an answer looks wrong or a cost looks too high, one switch stops everything at once.
rule:ai_pause_all.change: On: every AI call is refused and the reason 'paused' is written in the AI log. Existing suggestions and their decisions are kept.

rule:ai_default_provider.title: Default AI provider
rule:ai_default_provider.does: Chooses which provider the helpers use when an agent does not name one. local_rules runs on the phone for free. The other choices are paid providers and need a key, a model and a monthly budget first.
rule:ai_default_provider.why: A paid provider can spend money every month. Keeping local_rules as the default means no spending happens by accident.
rule:ai_default_provider.change: A paid provider is used only when it is enabled, has a model and a budget, and the data level it needs is allowed for it. The AI log shows each call.

rule:ai_speech_on.title: Voice questions (browser speech-to-text)
rule:ai_speech_on.does: Shows a microphone button in the assistant. The phone's own speech recognition turns the voice into text, which is then shown for the person to check before it is asked.
rule:ai_speech_on.why: Helps people who prefer speaking, including in Bangla. The text is still checked and redacted like typed text.
rule:ai_speech_on.default: Off. No microphone button is shown.
rule:ai_speech_on.change: On: the microphone button appears in the assistant. The question is still answered by the same rules and permissions as typed text.
